snippet.title: Vampire Huntress: Lament of the Sun - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror 2026
snippet.description:
Classic survival horror experience set in a dark gothic world. Play as Luna Ashcroft and explore an interconnected world filled with incomprehensible horrors, mind-bending puzzles and countless secrets. Are you ready to face the horrors of the night?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212500/Vampire_Huntress__Lament_of_the_Sun/

https://x.com/vh_lots_game"
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
